text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov and Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckovski arrive in New York to attend 51st U.N. General Assembly session.
- Macedonian investments are facing difficulties due to "expensive" credits.
- World Bank advises authorities to shut down Skopje refinery.
- Foreign Ministry formed a Diplomatic Council composed of eminent persons engaged in foreign policy.
- The city of Skopje becomes member of European Towns Against Narcotic Drugs (ECAD).
